metadata.title: Marriage Records for Family History: Where to find them on Ancestry.com & FamilySearch.org
metadata.author: Genealogy TV
metadata.shortDescription:
Learn about how marriage records can help you with your genealogy, some tips on how this research could add color to your family history, and where to find them on FamilySearch.org and Ancestry.com.

Links to articles mentioned:
➡️ Judy G. Russell - The Ties That Bond - Jan 25, 2012
https://www.legalgenealogist.com/2012/01/25/the-ties-that-bond/

➡️ Kimberly Powell - Types of Marriage Records for Family History Research - Updated October 14, 2019
https://www.thoughtco.com/marriage-records-types-4077752
